title: Optimize Guardrails Gating — SRE Rollout Checklist (Canary, Alerts, Paging, Rollback)
content:
Purpose
This checklist is the SRE launch gate for enabling Quality Guardrails “gating” on Optimize-driven config applies. It covers: (1) staged rollout (observe-only → soft-block → hard-block), (2) canary steps, (3) alert readiness + paging thresholds, and (4) rollback triggers.

Scope / what’s shipping
- Enforcement is at control plane “Optimize apply” (UI + API).
- Dependency on async eval runner + eval-harness gating mode output.
- Feature flags allow per-tenant/per-tier staged enforcement.
- Safe-degrade behavior when eval runner is unhealthy is tier-dependent (see below).

Owners / on-call
- Primary on-call: Guardrails / Control Plane on-call (SRE rotation monitors health + paging).
- DRI for rollout: Sean Gallagher (SRE lead).
- Release train coordination: Connor O’Brien.
- Control plane enforcement: Ethan Park.
- Telemetry: Logan Wright.

Environments / definitions
- Observe-only: gating evals run + results logged, but apply is not blocked.
- Soft-block: gating failures block apply by default, but override path exists behind RBAC + audit.
- Hard-block: gating failures block apply; override is either disabled or requires elevated break-glass (per policy).
- Canary tenant: internal tenant(s) + a small set of design partners with explicit opt-in.

Pre-launch readiness (must be checked before any production canary)
[ ] Code freeze windows reviewed (avoid large control-plane deploys during first 48h of canary).
[ ] Feature flags present and verified in prod:
    - optimize_guardrails_gating_mode: off | observe_only | soft_block | hard_block
    - optimize_guardrails_safe_degrade_policy: block | manual_approval | allow_with_audit (per tier)
    - optimize_guardrails_override_enabled: true/false (and RBAC gate)
    - optimize_guardrails_eval_cache_enabled: true/false
[ ] Runbook published + reviewed by SRE: “Optimize guardrails gating runbook” (link in Confluence artifacts).
[ ] Dashboards live in prod and accessible to on-call (no permission issues).
[ ] Alert rules merged + deployed (observability-pack/pr_441) AND tested (synthetic triggers in staging).
[ ] Audit events enabled in prod (OptimizeConfigChange + gating outcome fields) and verified in SIEM export if enabled for enterprise tenants.
[ ] Capacity check: eval runner worker pool capacity sized for expected canary load + 2x buffer.
[ ] Backlog protection: eval runner queue has configured max concurrency + shed policy (documented behavior when saturated).
[ ] Data retention policies confirmed:
    - eval artifacts retention (summaries vs raw artifacts) matches compliance guidance
    - audit logs retain minimal required fields even if artifacts expire
[ ] Incident comms plan drafted:
    - #incidents process + owning channel
    - #eng-sre + #eng-platform escalation mapping
    - CS/Support heads-up template (blocked applies / timeouts)

Observability & alert readiness (must be complete before soft-block/hard-block)
Signals (dashboards must show these as time series + segmented by env/region/tier)
[ ] Gating pass rate (%), by optimization type (quantization / batching / caching / routing) and by tenant tier.
[ ] Gating failure reasons (top N categories): metric regression, min sample size not met, eval run error, timeout, policy parse error, result schema invalid.
[ ] Eval runner health:
    - job queue depth
    - job start latency (time in queue)
    - job run latency (execution time)
    - error rate (by error class)
    - timeout rate
    - worker saturation (% busy)
[ ] Control plane apply endpoint:
    - request rate
    - apply latency p50/p95/p99
    - error rate (4xx/5xx), especially gating-decision-related 4xx
[ ] Safe-degrade mode activations count (blocked due to runner down vs manual approval required).
[ ] Override usage:
    - override count
    - override rate (overrides / blocked applies)
    - overrides by role (ensures RBAC is working)
    - overrides with missing justification (should be 0)
[ ] Post-change customer quality signals correlation (best-effort): support tickets tag, rollback rate, customer-reported degradation events.

Alerting: recommended thresholds (initial) + paging policy
Note: thresholds below are “first pass” for pilot/GA. We will tune after canary based on observed noise. Page only on user impact or systemic failure.

P0 (page immediately, 24/7)
[ ] Eval runner unavailable / systemic failure:
    - error rate > 10% for 10 minutes AND job queue depth increasing monotonically OR
    - timeout rate > 15% for 10 minutes OR
    - no successful eval jobs in 10 minutes while gating traffic > baseline
Action expectation: likely to cause widespread apply blocks/timeouts.

[ ] Control plane apply endpoint elevated 5xx:
    - 5xx rate > 1% for 5 minutes OR
    - p99 latency > 2x baseline for 10 minutes (while traffic stable)

[ ] Gating decision service correctness / determinism:
    - spike in “policy evaluation error / schema invalid / non-deterministic ordering” class > 0.5% for 10 minutes

P1 (page during business hours; off-hours page if canary tenants impacted)
[ ] Sustained increase in blocked applies:
    - blocked applies > 5% of apply attempts for 30 minutes in canary cohort (excluding expected failures from intentionally strict suites)

[ ] Override anomaly:
    - overrides > 10 in 1 hour OR override rate > 20% of blocked applies for 2 hours
Interpretation: thresholds too strict, false positives, or noisy graders.

P2 (ticket / async follow-up)
[ ] Eval queue depth above warning threshold (but draining): e.g., > 500 for > 30 min with stable completion rate.
[ ] Artifact persistence failures > 1% (audit logs still ok).
[ ] Dashboard/data pipeline gaps (missing model/version mapping) detected.

Canary plan (production)
Phase A — Observe-only (internal canary)
Goal: validate stability, latency/cost, and data correctness without user-blocking.
[ ] Enable observe-only for internal tenant(s) only.
[ ] Validate gating eval runs are triggered for all Optimize apply proposals in internal tenant.
[ ] Verify “gating summary” shows in Console (if UI flag enabled) and API returns gating metadata.
[ ] Validate audit logs include:
    - policy version
    - suite id + prompt-set revision
    - metric list + pass/fail
    - eval run id
[ ] Confirm eval result caching works (same config delta does not rerun) and invalidation works on model/prompt-set change.
[ ] Confirm no PII in telemetry labels; verify redaction rules (payload size limits) are enforced.
[ ] Exit criteria (Observe-only):
    - eval runner p95 job latency within SLO for 24 hours
    - timeout rate < 3% for 24 hours
    - no critical data integrity issues (model/version mismatch, missing suite metadata)

Phase B — Observe-only (design partner canary)
Goal: validate real customer prompt sets/workloads and ensure suite selection aligns.
[ ] Select 1–3 design partners with documented expectations (Aditya/Miguel coordinate).
[ ] Confirm tenant-level flags + safe-degrade policy configuration is correct per partner tier.
[ ] Establish a daily review loop of top failure reasons with Applied ML (Jonas/Selene/Sana).
[ ] Exit criteria:
    - at least N=30 applies evaluated across optimization types OR 2 weeks of steady traffic
    - failure reasons are understood; false-positive rate is acceptable for next phase

Phase C — Soft-block (internal)
Goal: prove operational workflows: blocked applies, override flow, and rollback hooks.
[ ] Enable soft-block for internal tenant(s).
[ ] Verify “blocked” UX state + API error codes are consistent and actionable.
[ ] Verify override is gated by RBAC and requires justification.
[ ] Validate override audit trail includes justification + approver identity.
[ ] Test safe-degrade behavior by simulating eval runner partial outage:
    - Confirm expected outcome per tier (block vs manual approval vs allow with audit)
[ ] Exit criteria:
    - no elevated 5xx on apply endpoint
    - override workflow used successfully at least once (test scenario) with correct audit logs
    - on-call runbook steps verified end-to-end

Phase D — Soft-block (design partners)
Goal: validate customer experience, Support/CS messaging, and operational burden.
[ ] Enable soft-block for design partners.
[ ] Ensure Support has macro/template for:
    - “apply blocked due to gating failure” explanation
    - “timeout” explanation + rerun request path
    - “request override” process and expected SLAs
[ ] Monitor:
    - blocked apply rate
    - override rate
    - timeouts and eval runner backlog
[ ] Exit criteria:
    - blocked apply rate stable and not driven by infra errors
    - timeout rate < 5% weekly
    - Support escalation volume manageable; clear playbook in place

Phase E — Hard-block (gradual)
Goal: default-on enforcement for broader cohorts.
[ ] Roll out hard-block by tenant tier and region (staged):
    1) internal
    2) design partners
    3) hosted growth tier
    4) dedicated / enterprise (per policy and safe-degrade stance)
[ ] Confirm “break-glass” policy for enterprise (if allowed) is documented + audited.
[ ] Re-validate alert thresholds; tighten paging as we expand.

Safe-degrade policy (when eval runner is unhealthy)
Decision summary (to align with PRD/ADR):
- Default stance: do not silently apply optimizations without a gating result.
- If runner down:
  - Hosted self-serve: block applies with clear error + retry guidance.
  - Dedicated/Enterprise: either (a) block, or (b) require manual approval flow (no auto-apply), depending on contract/tier policy.
Checklist items
[ ] For each tenant tier, confirm configured safe-degrade mode matches Product policy.
[ ] Confirm messaging is explicit (not “unknown error”): should say gating unavailable + next steps.
[ ] Confirm we have an operational bypass only via audited admin tooling (no hidden toggles).

Rollback plan (must be explicit before GA)
Rollback levers
[ ] Immediate: flip feature flag from soft/hard-block → observe-only globally.
[ ] Scoped: disable gating only for specific tenant(s) / region(s) if issue localized.
[ ] Disable only specific optimization type gating if false positives concentrated (e.g., quantization).
[ ] Throttle eval runner job creation rate (backpressure) while leaving observe-only logging on.

Rollback triggers (execute within 15 minutes for P0; within 60 minutes for P1)
P0 rollback triggers
[ ] Apply endpoint 5xx > 1% for 5 min attributable to gating.
[ ] Eval runner timeout rate > 20% for 10 min AND causing blocked applies/timeouts.
[ ] Systemic schema/policy bug causing incorrect blocks (e.g., parsing failure on common policies).

P1 rollback triggers
[ ] Blocked apply rate > 10% for 60 min in canary cohort AND failure reason suggests infra/noise (timeouts, runner errors).
[ ] Override rate > 30% for 4 hours (indicates gating too strict or noisy metrics) — roll back to observe-only while Applied ML retunes thresholds.

Post-rollback follow-ups
[ ] Open incident (if P0) with timeline + root cause.
[ ] File tuning tickets: adjust alert thresholds, runner capacity, timeouts, or suite selection mapping.
[ ] Communicate status to Product/Support + affected design partners.

Comms checklist
[ ] Pre-canary announcement in #eng-platform, #eng-sre, #product (include dates, flags, rollback plan).
[ ] Support enablement: doc links + macros + escalation path.
[ ] Release notes draft for internal users of Optimize (what changes, what to expect on blocked applies).
[ ] For design partners: send expectation email (Miguel/Aditya) including how to supply prompt sets and how overrides work.

GA sign-off checklist (final gate)
[ ] Observe-only ran in prod for >= 2 weeks with stable runner SLOs.
[ ] Soft-block ran for >= 1 week with manageable override volume and no major customer friction.
[ ] All P0/P1 alerts tested + on-call knows playbook steps.
[ ] Rollback lever tested in prod (flag flip) and verified takes effect within minutes.
[ ] Data correctness validated: model/version identity mapping consistent across hosted/dedicated/private (no “unknown model” buckets).
[ ] Security/RBAC review complete for overrides and audit log access.
[ ] Exec sponsor aware of default-on date (Priya Natarajan) and agrees with safe-degrade stance.

Notes / open questions (track here until resolved)
- What is the agreed SLO for eval runner job completion for gating (p95)? We currently assume “minutes,” but UX might require tighter for interactive applies.
- Can we separate “interactive apply” vs “scheduled apply” to avoid user waiting? (might affect paging thresholds)
- Should we allow per-tenant concurrency caps to avoid a single tenant saturating runner?
- How do we treat flaky rubric graders in alerting (error vs quality regression)? Applied ML to define standard classification.

Change log
- 2025-01-18 (Rafael): initial draft based on pilot plan.
- 2025-02-06 (Sean): added paging thresholds + rollback triggers.
- 2025-03-04 (Miles): clarified safe-degrade modes and added override anomaly alerting.
